page_title: 从安装到熟练使用轻阅 Markdown

summary.name: 轻阅 Markdown
summary.one_liner: A local Markdown editor (轻阅) with live rendering, formula and chart editing, optional AI editing tools, local image management and multi-format export.
use_cases: Writing and editing Markdown documents locally
Inserting and editing math formulas and charts without writing source
Exporting Markdown to DOCX, HTML, PDF or images
Managing images in Markdown via local assets or PicGo
Using AI tools to proofread, translate or polish text with confirmation before sending
Comparing and recovering conflicting document versions
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a Markdown editor with an instant-render mode that lets users edit headings, lists, quotes, tables and code in place, with a toggle to raw source. It offers a visual formula editor (95 templates) and chart editor (41 templates), plus a visual table editor and rich-text paste that converts web or Word content into Markdown. Exports cover 12 formats including DOCX, HTML, PDF and PNG/JPEG. Optional AI features (generate, proofread, translate, condense and similar) support several providers and require confirmation before any content is sent. Local version history keeps up to 30 versions per document and 100 MB globally, with side-by-side conflict comparison.
notable: Instant render mode with source toggle, and local version history with conflict comparison
Visual formula editor (95 templates) and chart editor (41 templates)
Optional AI editing with masking of sensitive information before sending
Exports to 12 formats including DOCX, HTML, PDF with bookmarks
caveats: AI features depend on third-party provider accounts or API access, which the user supplies
Some Windows and macOS features such as in-app updates apply only on those platforms
Complex syntax falls back to source editing
